description: Ministry of Sports - Order to amend the Gaz. Ex. No. 1990/23 of 27.10.2016, adding new Sport class "66. surfing to the Sports Act" No. 25 of 1973
categorisation: This gazette content is an order made under the Sports Act, No. 25 of 1973, which amends a schedule to add a new sport/sport class. This constitutes a regulatory matter involving the modification of subsidiary legislation, fitting the definition of Legal/Regulatory Gazettes (Type 5). While a Minister is named, the content does not focus on government personnel changes or portfolio responsibilities, but rather on the legal/regulatory action being taken.
